title: Ox Passion Paradise Punch Nic Salts E-Liquid 10ml
description: OX Passion Salts Paradise Punch delivers a vibrant medley of tropical fruits, blending the lush sweetness of ripe Mango and juicy Pineapple with a burst of citrusy Orange. The inhale unfolds with rich, sun-ripened mango and golden pineapple, while the exhale is lifted by the bright zest of orange, creating a refreshingly smooth and balanced vape. Blended in a 50VG/50PG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid is designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, providing a smooth throat hit and layered, well-defined flavour. Perfect for pod vape kits and starter devices, it ensures rapid nicotine absorption for a consistently satisfying vape experience. Developed by Oxva, a trusted name in vaping technology, the OX Passion Salts range features expertly crafted flavours designed to pair seamlessly with Oxva’s XLIM pod kits and other refillable vape devices.
